from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the provided collection, capturing its title and outgoing references to other collection papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper being analyzed")
    references_to_collection: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of other provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list/bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
